content.comment_body: I'm having trouble with [product_name] V5 after upgrading my computer's hard drive. Previously, V5 worked perfectly. Now, when I try to open a file, the program becomes unresponsive and I have to force close it using Windows Task Manager. I removed all versions and installed V3, which works without problems. After upgrading again to V5, the program locks up when opening or saving files. Creating new files is possible, but saving doesn't work. Has anyone experienced the same issue or have any advice?
I'm facing a similar issue. V4 works without problems, but after upgrading to V5, [product_name] freezes when opening files. V4 continues to function well.
Hello all, you may find help in this FAQ: [document], Entry ID [article_no]. [user_name] Moderator: The correct link is here: [document].

Thanks a lot, it's working now. I just can't switch the Look&Feel back to ExtendedWindows, but the Windows setting works fine, so that's sufficient for me. Can anyone explain the reason why this happens? My setup includes: Dell Latitude D610, 1GB RAM, 80GB HD, 2GHz CPU, ATI MOBILITY RADEON X300 (1400x1050), Windows XP Professional with all updates and patches, JRE 1.5.0_07. Here’s the solution that worked for me (slightly different from Entry ID [article_no]): After updating [product_name] from V4 to V5, I wasn't able to open any file; trying to open via toolbar or menu caused the program to freeze. Adding 'app.laf=javax.swing.plaf.metal.MetalLookAndFeel' to the file C:\Documents and Settings\user\.[product_name]5\Application.ini solved the issue. It works with both Metal and Windows Look&Feel, but not with ExtendedWindows.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that [product_name] version 5 repeatedly freezes when trying to open or save files after upgrading from earlier, stable versions. The problem appears related to Look & Feel settings; using the Windows or Metal themes allows the application to function, whereas ExtendedWindows does not. Prior versions (V3, V4) do not encounter this problem. Although the freezing was resolved with a workaround, the exact cause and the reason for the theme issue remain unclear.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable performance from the latest software version, as well as compatibility with their system and interface preferences without encountering stability issues.
